purpose: Freeze one marine-matrix accessibility metric before demographic outcomes are joined.

metric.name: breeding-season open-water access distance
metric.monthly_value: Distance in km from the breeding site to the nearest valid ocean grid-cell center with sea-ice concentration below 15 percent.
metric.epoch_value: Median monthly distance over all November-January fields inside the site's already-frozen early or late terrestrial epoch.
metric.standardized_favorable_change: M = -(late_distance - early_distance), so larger M means closer open water.

support_gate.h2_opens_if: At least 80 percent of terrestrial-metric eligible sites have both epoch values, with at least two species and two regions represented.

inferential_role.h2_model: relative_reallocation ~ land_change + marine_access_change + land_change:marine_access_change + frozen regional/species structure

boundaries: This is regional access through the marine matrix, not a route-level crack/lead metric.
Closer open water does not directly measure prey availability.
No alternative sea-ice threshold is selected using demographic outcomes.
